title: Print message
description: Print a line of text.
explanation: Print a line of text.
usage: Use this when you need to print a line of text.
mistakes: Java statements usually end with semicolons; String literals use double quotes.

title: Variable
description: Declare a typed variable.
explanation: Declare a typed variable.
usage: Use this when you need to declare a typed variable.
mistakes: Variable names are case sensitive and cannot be reserved words.

title: Primitive types
description: Choose primitive types for simple values.
explanation: Choose primitive types for simple values.
usage: Use this when you need to choose primitive types for simple values.
mistakes: Use double for decimal examples; integer division truncates.

title: Condition
description: Branch based on a boolean expression.
explanation: Branch based on a boolean expression.
usage: Use this when you need to branch based on a boolean expression.
mistakes: Use == for primitive comparisons and .equals() for String contents.

title: For loop
description: Repeat an action using an index.
explanation: Repeat an action using an index.
usage: Use this when you need to repeat an action using an index.
mistakes: Array indexes begin at zero and end before length.

title: Array
description: Store a fixed-size sequence of numbers.
explanation: Store a fixed-size sequence of numbers.
usage: Use this when you need to store a fixed-size sequence of numbers.
mistakes: Array size is fixed after creation.

title: For each
description: Iterate through an array.
explanation: Iterate through an array.
usage: Use this when you need to iterate through an array.
mistakes: The loop variable type must match the array element type.

title: While loop
description: Repeat while a condition is true.
explanation: Repeat while a condition is true.
usage: Use this when you need to repeat while a condition is true.
mistakes: Update the loop counter or it may never terminate.

title: String comparison
description: Compare string contents correctly.
explanation: Compare string contents correctly.
usage: Use this when you need to compare string contents correctly.
mistakes: == compares String references; equals compares contents.

title: Scanner input
description: Read a line of terminal input.
explanation: Read a line of terminal input.
usage: Use this when you need to read a line of terminal input.
mistakes: Mixing nextInt and nextLine can leave a trailing newline to consume.

title: ArrayList
description: Store a list that can grow.
explanation: Store a list that can grow.
usage: Use this when you need to store a list that can grow.
mistakes: Use wrapper types such as Integer, not primitive int, in generic lists.

title: HashMap
description: Look up values by key.
explanation: Look up values by key.
usage: Use this when you need to look up values by key.
mistakes: get may return null; getOrDefault provides a fallback.

title: Static method
description: Declare a method inside the Main class.
explanation: Declare a method inside the Main class.
usage: Use this when you need to declare a method inside the Main class.
mistakes: Methods must be declared inside Main but outside main.

title: Nested class
description: Define a reusable type inside Main.
explanation: Define a reusable type inside Main.
usage: Use this when you need to define a reusable type inside Main.
mistakes: A nested type used from static main needs to be static or separately instantiated.

title: Create object
description: Construct an object and call its methods.
explanation: Construct an object and call its methods.
usage: Use this when you need to construct an object and call its methods.
mistakes: Construct an object with new before using instance methods.

title: Inheritance
description: Override behavior in a child class.
explanation: Override behavior in a child class.
usage: Use this when you need to override behavior in a child class.
mistakes: Keep overridden method signatures compatible with the parent.

title: Interface
description: Define and implement a behavior contract.
explanation: Define and implement a behavior contract.
usage: Use this when you need to define and implement a behavior contract.
mistakes: An interface implementation must use public for the implemented method.

title: Catch exception
description: Handle an invalid numeric conversion.
explanation: Handle an invalid numeric conversion.
usage: Use this when you need to handle an invalid numeric conversion.
mistakes: Catch the specific exception you expect from the conversion.

title: Read file
description: Read a UTF-8 text file and handle errors.
explanation: Read a UTF-8 text file and handle errors.
usage: Use this when you need to read a UTF-8 text file and handle errors.
mistakes: File reads may throw IOException; check the path and handle the exception.

title: Write file
description: Write a UTF-8 text file.
explanation: Write a UTF-8 text file.
usage: Use this when you need to write a UTF-8 text file.
mistakes: writeString replaces an existing file by default.

title: Sort list
description: Sort a mutable list.
explanation: Sort a mutable list.
usage: Use this when you need to sort a mutable list.
mistakes: List.of is immutable; copy it into ArrayList before sorting.

title: Stream filter
description: Filter a collection with a stream.
explanation: Filter a collection with a stream.
usage: Use this when you need to filter a collection with a stream.
mistakes: Stream.toList requires Java 16+ and returns an unmodifiable list.

title: Optional
description: Represent and handle a missing value.
explanation: Represent and handle a missing value.
usage: Use this when you need to represent and handle a missing value.
mistakes: Do not call get on an empty Optional; use a fallback or check first.

title: Enum
description: Define a fixed set of named values.
explanation: Define a fixed set of named values.
usage: Use this when you need to define a fixed set of named values.
mistakes: Use an enum for a closed set of choices.

title: Record
description: Define an immutable data carrier.
explanation: Define an immutable data carrier.
usage: Use this when you need to define an immutable data carrier.
mistakes: Records require Java 16+ and have final component fields.

title: Formatted output
description: Format a numeric value to one decimal place.
explanation: Format a numeric value to one decimal place.
usage: Use this when you need to format a numeric value to one decimal place.
mistakes: Use %n for the platform newline and match format types to arguments.

title: Complete grade report
description: Calculate and display an average.
explanation: Calculate and display an average.
usage: Use this when you need to calculate and display an average.
mistakes: Cast before division to avoid truncating the average to an integer.
